## Key points to check1: Enter Attendance Data Even if the professors are managing attendance separately using handwritten attendance sheets or other means for each class, it is still necessary to input the attendance data on LMS. Attendance processing completed to date (including make-up classes). There is no attendance data in [View Subsections]. **==> picture [374 x 266] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [374 x 266] intentionally omitted <==** --- end of page.page_number=6 --- ## Key points to check2: Check for Null(-) Attendance Data. You should process the data marked with ‘-’ in [View Subsections] to input grades. **==> picture [895 x 39] intentionally omitted <==** **----- Start of picture text -----**
a. If the attendance data for a specific week-session is all marked with ‘-’, it means that attendance has not been recorded normally for that entire data set.

You should process the data marked with ‘-’ in [View Subsections] to input grades. **==> picture [895 x 50] intentionally omitted <==** **----- Start of picture text -----**
b. If attendance for the relevant week was properly recorded at the beginning of the semester but the attendance status of some students is marked with ‘-’: These are students who
began attending the class after the start date, during the course adjustment period or additional course registration.
**----- End of picture text -----**
**==> picture [188 x 264] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [215 x 264] intentionally omitted <==** Student name(No.) Select ‘Attendance Status’ Since the student was not on the attendance sheet at the time of attendance processing, such as with smart attendance, the detailed attendance history will not be recorded. You can enter a brief reason for the change in preparation for audits, etc. In the first week, although most students are recorded as present or absent in each session, if some students are marked with ‘-’, the system will recognize this as an unresolved status. Therefore, it is necessary to confirm their attendance status. To confirm the attendance status, click on [View Components] and select each week-session marked with ‘-’. After modifying the data, be sure to click the apply button. --- end of page.page_number=8 --- ## Key points to check2: Check for Null(-) Attendance Data. You should process the data marked with ‘-’ in [View Subsections] to input grades. c. If a session conducted as a video lecture shows a ‘-’, it means that the video is currently within the viewing period. **==> picture [297 x 203] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [304 x 263] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [149 x 260] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [57 x 260] intentionally omitted <==** In the Weekly Learning menu, if ‘Attendance Applicable(출결대상임)’ is checked, students who have not viewed the content within the set ‘Learning Recognition Period(학습인정기간)’ up to the time of inquiry will be displayed as ‘-’ in the [View Subsections] screen. --- end of page.page_number=9 --- ## Key points to check2: Check for Null(-) Attendance Data. You should process the data marked with ‘-’ in [View Subsections] to input grades. c. If a session conducted as a video lecture shows a ‘-’, it means that the video is currently within the viewing period. **==> picture [162 x 261] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [47 x 261] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [115 x 66] intentionally omitted <==** Name(No.) 학생명 The attendance is recorded as present because the student completed it within the attendance recognition period. Once the viewing is completed, the system will mark the attendance. If not viewed within the period, it will be marked as absence. You can check the detailed attendance history by clicking on each student's attendance data in [View components]. --- end of page.page_number=10 --- ## Key points to check3: Assignment of Flipped Learning (VOD) Class Sessions The flipped learning classes do not have assigned dates in the [View Subsections]. **==> picture [362 x 236] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [417 x 265] intentionally omitted <==** Online classes, such as flipped learning, are assigned as the last class of each week in the [View Subsections], and the class date for flipped learning is not displayed. Flipped learning video classes must be assigned to the session marked with the class date (온라인 강좌 online course). --- end of page.page_number=11 --- ## Key Checkpoint 3: Assignment of Flipped Learning (VOD) Class Sessions The flipped learning classes do not have assigned dates in the [View Subsections]. **==> picture [208 x 241] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [222 x 241] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [217 x 240] intentionally omitted <==** **==> picture [261 x 239] intentionally omitted <==** Assignment of VOD for flipped learning sessions (3 sessions for each week). There is no attendance data in [View Subsections] because VOD has not been assigned to the flipped learning session. --- end of page.page_number=12 ---
